sloka: स प्रभावेण शूलस्य दौरात्म्येनात्मनस्तथा ।सन्तापयति लोकांस्त्रीन्विशेषेण च तापसान् ।। ७.६१.२१ ॥
transliteration: sa prabhāveṇa śūlasya daurātmyenātmanastathā ।santāpayati lokāṁstrīnviśeṣeṇa ca tāpasān ।। 7.61.21 ॥

translations.english: Lavana, by the power of the trident and his own wickedness, torments the three worlds, especially the ascetics.
